description.from:
Find usable stock images for a Story and bring one in. Royalty-free is required. Wikimedia Commons is the first source; others sit behind the same source interface.

Open decision for Ryan: credits. Licence terms vary per image: Commons images can require attribution or share-alike. Ryan's standing rule is no image credits except Source and Illustrative. Either search only licences that need no credit, or show a credit where the licence demands one.

Source licence terms must be read from each provider's own documents before any adapter ships.
description.to:
Find usable stock images for a Story and bring one in. Royalty-free is required. Wikimedia Commons is the first source; others sit behind the same source interface.

Decision (Ryan 2026-11-05): every third-party image shows a credit, whether or not its licence requires attribution. Licences that also impose terms, such as share-alike, still have to be checked per image.

Source licence terms must be read from each provider's own documents before any adapter ships.
